pages.text: Two trees grow here. $(l)Glowwood$(/l) is the cyan building wood. $(l)Glowroot$(/l) is the signature self-lit species — its whole wood set glows faintly. Both have full sets: planks, stairs, slabs, fences, doors, signs, boats, and more.

Plant a sapling to grow a tree. Glowroot grows a spreading 2x2 tree when four saplings are planted together — and a town-sized giant generates in the world. Strip logs with an axe for the smooth variant.
